init.title: Remote 3 combined display
init.description: Enable one display for TiviMuse, Nuvio and SmartTube. Select the Shield media player for playback metadata and its Android TV/ADB media player for the foreground app. Existing compatible display settings are suggested when one legacy display entry is found. TiviMuse always supplies its own guide data and logo. TMDB is optional and only used for Nuvio/SmartTube.
